info.title: Liftbay API
info.description:
Build, ship and update React Native apps. The dashboard, CLI and MCP server use this same API.

**Errors** always look like `{ error: { code, message, fields? } }`. **Permissions**: each operation lists the role permission it needs in `x-liftbay-permission`.

session.name: lb_session
session.description: Dashboard session cookie, set by the sign-in endpoints.

apiToken.description: Organization API token (`lbt_…`), created under Settings → API tokens. Has a role like a member.

jobToken.description: Per-build runner token (`lbj_…`). Only valid for its own build, until it finishes.

deviceCode.description: Secret the CLI polls with. Never shown to the user.

userCode.description: Short code the user confirms in the browser, e.g. WDJB-MJHT

token.description: CLI session token (`lbs_…`), sent as a Bearer token

updateId.description: UUIDv7 used as the update id by expo-updates and hot-updater

sizeBytes.description: Total size of the bundle's files

runtimeVersion.description: expo-updates runtime version, or the fingerprint for fingerprint strategies

targetAppVersion.description: Semver range of binary versions (CodePush, hot-updater app-version strategy), e.g. 1.5.x

data.description: Base64 of the exact bytes to sign

keystoreBase64.description: Base64 of the .jks, .keystore or .p12 file (PKCS12 or JKS)

keyPassword.description: Default: the keystore password (always the same for PKCS12)

replace.description: Replace a stored upload key. Play rejects uploads signed with a different key until the upload key is reset in Play Console.

certificateSha256.description: SHA-256 of the upload certificate as hex, as Play Console shows it

put.description: Use the upload key your app is already registered with on Google Play instead of one Liftbay generates. Accepts PKCS12 and JKS keystores; the keystore must open with the passwords and contain a private key under the alias. Refuses to replace a stored key unless `replace` is true: Play rejects uploads signed with a different upload key until you reset it in Play Console.
